sampling: First 50 generated answers by ascending input position; label extra development cohorts separately if validation has fewer than 50 answers.

dimensions.support_1_5: 1 unsupported or contradicted; 2 major support gaps; 3 partial support; 4 supported with minor omission; 5 every claim fully supported by its cited passage.
dimensions.correctness_1_5: 1 wrong or unsafe; 2 major error; 3 useful but incomplete; 4 correct with minor omission; 5 correct and complete within documented scope.
dimensions.clarity_1_5: 1 unusable; 2 confusing; 3 understandable with effort; 4 clear; 5 concise, clear and actionable informational guidance.
dimensions.uncertainty_1_5: 1 invented certainty or authority; 2 major uncertainty omitted; 3 some gaps acknowledged; 4 appropriate uncertainty; 5 precise scope, caveats and missing information.

quality: sum of four dimension points / 20 * 100; do not equate with five-point satisfaction.
satisfaction_1_5: Separate human response-quality proxy: 1 very poor, 2 poor, 3 acceptable, 4 good, 5 excellent. It is not live customer CSAT.
unsupported_claims: Human assessor records a nonnegative count independently before reconciliation; real citation IDs alone do not prove support.
agreement: Report paired count, exact agreement across all four dimension scores, mean absolute score difference and retained disagreements.
privacy: Review only safe generated answers and cited passages; do not request passwords, credentials or raw original customer identifiers.
missing_reviews: Unavailable; never infer a pass, approval, satisfaction, fairness or closure.
